posts.title_en: Update notes for Thursday 8 October
posts.summary_en: Official 10-08 patch note. It adds the SSR Grass Support Chardonnay Cookie (straight-line ally buff: CRIT chance, push resistance and Volley synergy, plus damage to enemies), raises the cookie level cap to 120 and cuts Lv.79-100 EXP costs with a refund, and opens Rumble Arena Season 2 with a single generic sentence (no passive, dates or rewards). Arena help text gains a line on how mercenary effects apply; a 7-day attendance event gives Milk Cookie's Crunchy Strong Pediatrician. No cookie, pet or Arena balance change is listed; comments complain that 쟁탈전 is again absent and that Rumble hides opponents past 2,000 points.
mechanics: Chardonnay Cookie (샤르도네맛 쿠키): SSR, 풀속성 (Grass), 지원형 (Support), skill '신록의 성역'. Note text: '신록의 장벽으로 직선 상의 아군에게 치명확률과 밀어내기 저항을 올려 주고 다발 시너지를 제공하며, 적에게 피해를 입힙니다.' The official card GIF (nv-50417-2.gif, first frame) shows 'SSR · 풀속성 · 지원', five stars and two synergy icons.
Cookie level cap: '쿠키 최대 레벨 상한이 120레벨까지 확장됩니다.'
Lv.79-100 EXP requirement cut (e.g. Lv.99 11,820,527 -> 2,391,174; Lv.100 13,911,155 -> 3,347,644); EXP spent above the new requirement is refunded by mail.
Gnome Lab basic research extended to 130-2 and special research to 22 (screenshot nv-50417-5 shows 연구 130-2 체력 증폭 60.00%).
rules: Rumble Arena: '■ 와글와글 아레나 시즌2 오픈 - 모든 서버의 용병단들과 대결하는 경쟁 콘텐츠 와글와글 아레나의 새로운 시즌이 시작됩니다.' No passive, dates, length or reward changes are stated.
Arena: '■ 아레나 도움말 문구 보완 - 아레나 도움말 내 용병단 효과 적용에 대한 안내 문구가 추가됩니다.' The note does not quote the new wording.
10-02 fixes listed: boss-summon mission counts in Dimensional Rift, Crumble Pass and 와글와글 스페셜 패스 (Rumble Special Pass).

Events: Chardonnay pickup with missions (points reset at event end); 초코왕방울 roulette; new 7-day attendance whose Day 7 reward is the SSR '바삭튼튼 소아과 의사 우유맛 쿠키' (nv-50417-8: Day 1 10 cutters?, Day 2 1,000 ?, Day 3 2 coin time tickets?, Day 4 60 ?, Day 5 2 dough time tickets?, Day 6 500 crystals?, Day 7 SSR Milk ×1). The event tab bar in nv-50417-6/7/8 shows a separate '와글와글 아레나' event tab.
No balance change to cookies, pets or Arena/Rumble rules appears in the note. PvE-only changes: daily dungeon difficulty cuts, stage boss-fight add ATK reduced below the boss.
disagreements: Level cap: the official note says 120. The teamhobby datamine page (03-sites/teamhobby_patchnotes.html, 'v1.5 ... 다음 업데이트 적용 예상') says 'Lv.100 → Lv.150', and a commenter on yt-OKBiO8_0J38 says '쿠키레벨 150꺼지'. The official note governs.
Daily dungeons: teamhobby's datamine lists '일일 던전 5종 770 → 900단계'; the official note has no dungeon extension and many commenters complain about exactly that.

posts.title_en: Small tips even veterans might not know
posts.summary_en: A tips post by 가방은 항상 두개 (written with Guild Conquest and dungeons in mind, but the mechanics are general). Synergy-giving cookies buff synergy receivers first (Pomegranate to Milk, Macaron to Milky Way), pet ATK buffs change the ATK ranking used for buff targeting, DR stacks multiplicatively (10% + 10% = 19%), and Skill Haste follows CD × 100 / (100 + haste). Debuff chance scales with focus over resist.
mechanics: Synergy givers buff synergy receivers first: '석류->우유 뿐만아니라 마카롱 ->밀키 처럼 시너지때문에 오히려 손해인 경우도 있다' (in Guild Conquest Macaron's buff often goes to Milky Way and is not a straight line).
ATK ranking for buffs includes pet ATK buffs: with equal 100K ATK, Octo Wasabi sends Pomegranate's buff to Scorpion; a 전지 pet sends it to Melon Soda.
DR stacks multiplicatively: Icy Birdie 10% + DR perk 10% = 81% damage taken = 19% DR, not 20%.
DEF uses a log function in the power formula.
Skill Haste: real CD = (base CD) / (haste + 100) × 100; CD 10 s with haste 10 -> 9.09 s, haste 20 -> 8.33 s (diminishing returns).
Debuff chance = base chance × (my focus) / (target resist); e.g. 20% × 400 / 200 = 40%. Resist and focus are better the higher they are, unlike accuracy.

quotes.kr: 얼음과자새 10% 이후 받는 피해량 90%에서 다시 10%를 적용하여 81% 피해를 입는 19% 피해감소 효과가 적용된다.
quotes.en: After Icy Birdie's 10%, damage taken is 90%; the next 10% applies to that, so you take 81%: a 19% damage reduction.

quotes.kr: (기존 쿨타임) / (스킬가속 +100) ×100 의 공식이기에
quotes.en: Because the formula is (base cooldown) / (Skill Haste + 100) × 100.

posts.title_en: Recommended guide for new and returning players
posts.summary_en: Long beginner guide by 백산. For PvP: Arena is per server and Rumble Arena is cross-server; current Arena/Rumble gear values evasion, crit chance, crit resist, Skill Haste and Skill AMP, built as either an evasion preset or a crit-resist preset (each also with Skill AMP, crit chance, accuracy). Arena refills one ticket every 2 hours; Rumble tickets refill to max at midnight; both have a free opponent refresh every 30 minutes. Rumble's passive changes every season, so its meta changes each season. Its dungeon screenshots show a '쟁탈전' tab in the dungeon menu.

builds.sugar_runes: General (not PvP-specific) list: 우유 공증; 마카롱 스증; 치즈케이크 스증; 석류 스증; 다크초코 스가, 집중; 피겨 스증, 스가; 피노누아 스가, 집중; 허브 스가, 스증; 브라이트시커 스가; 전갈 스증; 실론 스증; 달토끼 스가, 집중; 체리콜라 스증.
builds.gear: Arena/Rumble: evasion, crit chance, crit resist, Skill Haste, Skill AMP are the key lines. Evasion deck: evasion + Skill AMP, crit chance, accuracy. Crit-resist deck: crit resist + Skill AMP, crit chance, accuracy.
builds.why: The PvP preset meta changes with the deck meta.

mechanics: Hidden recommended-power damage tiers exist in PvE (e.g. 35% vs 55% damage bands); low accuracy causes misses and low focus fails debuffs.
rules: Arena runs per server; Rumble Arena, guilds and Guild Conquest are cross-server.
Diamonds can buy Arena and Rumble opponent refreshes, but a free refresh is given every 30 minutes.
Arena: fame medals only on wins; victory medals by tier; 1 ticket recharges every 2 hours. Suggested victory-medal shop order: 쇳물, 초코강, Stellar points.
Rumble: wins give 와글와글 medals only (no fame medals). Shop order: dough dungeon ticket, gold dungeon ticket, EXP ticket, 쇳물. 'Rumble tickets refill to the maximum at midnight every day.'
'와레나는 매 시즌별로 적용되는 패시브가 달라져 매번 메타가 바뀌게 됩니다.'
Mileage order: daily dungeon keys > Arena ticket > Stellar.
Gear presets: up to 5.
